verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt served with HTTP 200 at docs.openclaw.ai/llms.txt, and a second llms.txt exists at openclaw.ai. The docs pages are themselves served as raw Markdown (.md URLs), which suits agents; the 404 probe was only a doubled .md.md path. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or a documented guide on pointing agents at the docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
